json_ld.description:
Iron More Quickly: make ironing faster and easier than ever before; cover is designed with an innovative silicone coating which reflects heat and does not absorb it; this coating helps make ironing more effective to give you perfect and wrinkle free clothes in no time
Resists Scorching and Staining: no more scorched or burned ironing board covers; the thick and durable silicone coated material is made to resist scorching and staining up to 400 degrees, even after many uses; use on heat safe surfaces
Stays In Place: cover features a nose pocket, hook and loop fasteners and elastic edges to help keep it in place and prevent shifting while ironing; includes not one but two hook and loop fastener straps on the underside and strong elasticized edges around the entire border
Extra Thick Padding: thick padded cover provides a barrier and extra layer of protection between your clothes and the board; helping to prevent the mesh from the board transferring onto your clothing
Secure Fit on Most Standard Boards: cover measures 15 inches by 54 inches, making it a perfect fit for all standard sized ironing boards; the elasticized edges and hook and loop fasteners make installation extremely easy; please note that the ironing board is not included with the cover
json_ld.name: Ironing Board Cover
